lines.speaker: Hex
lines.text: Beep-bop… Scanning… Unknown lifeform detected. Identification running… running… running… Scan failed. What exactly are you?

lines.speaker: Hex
lines.text: Friendliness cannot be confirmed. Threat level: moderately concerning.

lines.speaker: Oris
lines.text: What is that supposed to mean?

lines.speaker: Hex
lines.text: You look like someone who touches things they’re not supposed to touch.

choices.text: What are you even doing out here?

lines.speaker: Oris
lines.text: Okay, but what are you doing out here?

lines.speaker: Hex
lines.text: I patrol this area. Regulation 47c: 'Maintain visual contact with unusual organic subjects'. You match all criteria.

lines.speaker: Oris
lines.text: Alright… have you seen someone named Sam by any chance?

lines.speaker: Hex
lines.text: Match found: a human named Sam passed through this area recently. He was running. Very fast.

lines.speaker: Hex
lines.text: Because he stood between me and my charging station. That is forbidden across the entire galaxy.

lines.speaker: Oris
lines.text: Can you tell me where he went?

lines.speaker: Hex
lines.text: Negative. But I can tell you where *you* should go: north. Footprints. Strange energy signatures.

lines.speaker: Hex
lines.text: Confirmation: You are chaos. I will continue observing you. Beep-bop.
